scope: Independent read-only review of the uncommitted cattle/species UI change. No runtime edits, builds or deployments.

checks.scientificGates: Animal display clones complete unpooled descriptive cells; inferenceEligible and patternFinderEligible are false, all p/q aliases are null, sensitivity reason is explicit, and unavailable zero/zero combinations are not promoted to estimates.
checks.sourcePreservation: Original association and complete table are not mutated. The original complete unpooled values remain available in their own lazy table; source datasets, estimator and gates are unchanged.
checks.counts: Count unit explicitly states location/date clusters per craft/species combination. Fractional expected averages are retained in hover, inspection and exact chart table.
checks.expectedControls: Four matched-date controls matches contextFeatureAssociation implementation: minus two years, minus one year, plus one year and plus two years; expected cell counts sum their cluster counts and divide by four.
checks.taxonomy: Named species remain separate, ordered by observed cluster volume with unknown last. The animal column bound is 16 while the global/craft row bound remains 12. The complete table retains rows beyond the display bound.
checks.cropRegression: Non-animal lanes retain original pooled cell reference, morphology formatter, pooling disclosure and default expected-count formatter. Generic heatmaps retain their previous column limits unless speciesColumns is true.
checks.controls: Lane selector remains present and re-renders the selected lane. Inspectable cells preserve click and keyboard inspection paths; no shared filter mutation is introduced.
checks.regression: node tests/test_analysis_animal_species_display.mjs passed, including source immutability, control-only species, fractional expected values, inference rejection, all named columns, row truncation and crop-path checks.

nonblockingNotes: git diff --check treats the new CRLF lines in the -text analysis_view.js file as trailing whitespace; no runtime consequence. Avoid broad line-ending normalization of this large runtime file.
limits: Root independently verifies real-data browser appearance, tests and release preparation. This receipt does not claim deployment.

storage.purpose: Small independent QA evidence for the current species display change. Retain with release evidence.
